The '''bomber command post''', a military installation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], was originally the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] '''Waypoint Station Draay''' or '''Draay Outpost''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It served as a secure base for soldiers and medical personnel during the reconstruction of Taris. It was located south of [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]], on the Western Shore of [[Lake Brell]] in the Brell Sediment.

==Personnel==
Commander [[Gardit]] was in charge of Waypoint Station Draay during the Cold War, commanding the various Republic scouts, riflemen and officers. The medical droid [[CB-08-4]] was also located at Draay, as well as [[Kahrin Wek]], [[Kon Yel]], and Agent [[Welkins]]. Doctor [[Ianna Cel]] sent a [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|traveling hero]] to Draay to consult with the medical droid after the hero volunteered to be infected with the [[rakghoul]] virus.
